The subtitles fact reports captions for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At phone width the transcript under the player carries the caption and highlights the spoken word (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png), which is the chosen layout. The toc fact lists seven chapters, each one landing exactly on its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the matching chapter going active, and every chapter visible at 1280x800 in all three languages. The desktop screenshots show all seven titles with their times down the left side; the phone screenshots show a 'Chapter 1 of 7' picker with back and forward buttons and a dropdown, so a worried patient can reach any chapter at either width.

The languages fact shows es and zh-Hans each loading their own title, audio file and first sentence with audio_language matching. In guide-es-desktop.png the title, language label, chapter list, transcript, caption, buttons and the call-for-help block are all Spanish; in guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png they are all Mandarin, including the speed and captions controls. No English left over on either page, at desktop or phone.

The provider_file fact records paste to link in 21 ms, no requests after load, and zero account or login fields, so nothing to sign into and no new app. provider-draft.png shows the pasted dot phrase on the left and the table on the right with Antibiotic, Pain medication, Follow-up, Language and Reviewed by; where the note still has ***, the page says it cannot read the line, offers Yes/No and a 'Use the draft default' button rather than guessing. provider-filled.png shows the same table reading a filled block: antibiotic No, pain medication Yes, follow-up 10/01/2026, Spanish, each marked 'your block' and each still overridable. guide-from-link.png opens in Spanish with the date in the transcript as 'Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026'.

The review_line fact shows one line in the block, 'Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***', no clinician badge, and no review date in the link. provider-filled.png says next to Reviewed by: not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link, it stays in your note. guide-from-link-badges.png, with the transcript scrolled to the end of chapter 7, shows no reviewer line and no review date, which matches what the provider page promises.

The card_summary fact reports the card on the first screen at both widths and the card itself returning 200. 'Print the card' is one tap in the header in guide-en-desktop.png and under the player without scrolling in guide-en-phone.png, and the same link appears translated in the Spanish and Mandarin shots.
